_comment: Confirmed against live Bitget SPOT tickers on 2026-07-31 using 'r' prefix + USDT pair convention (e.g. MU -> rMU, traded as rMUUSDT). null = confirmed NOT available as a Bitget tokenized stock -- not a missing mapping, a real product gap. Re-check periodically as Bitget's tokenized-stock catalog grows.

_cash_proxies._comment: Grok sometimes parks weight in T-bill ETFs (e.g. SGOV) as a cash-equivalent. Bitget doesn't tokenize these. Held as idle USDT instead of traded.

_unavailable_on_bitget._comment: Confirmed via live API check, not just absent from this file. Distinct from _cash_proxies -- these are real equity positions Grok wants, Bitget just doesn't offer them tokenized. Re-run the mapping-suggestion workflow periodically in case Bitget adds them.
